EVALUATION OF CANDIDATES
In pursuant to the advertisement dated 25.10.2024 inviting willingness to act as 'Ad-hoc translator', 92 applications
were received. Out of total 92, 86 applications were found defect free. Out of 86 applicants, 74 candidates were found
eligible as per the conditions prescribed in the notice dated 25.10.2024, and hence those 74 candidates were called for
personal interaction with the Editorial Board on 09.12.2024, 10.12.2024, 16.12.2024, 17.1 2.2024 and 18.12.2024. Out
of 74 candidates, only 47 candidates appeared and hence evaluated, 2 candidates were declared disqualified for not
fulfilling criteria as to advocate and place of practice, and 25 candidates remained absent. The Editorial Board tested
the candidates' translation skills, their prior experience in translation, familiarity with equivalent Hindi terms for the
English legal terms as well as their comprehensibility of the text of judgmenls and the communication skill and their
overall suitability for the role. In order to shortlist the right candidates for the work of translation, the Editorial Board
evaluated the candidates into the following grades:-
0 for Outstanding
A+ for Very good
A for Good
B for Average
c for Below average
D for Not satisfactory
All the 47 candidates, who appeared for personal intemction, were evaluated both in writing 3$ well as in viva-voce,
and were assigned gradation accordingly against their respective names by the Editorial Board keeping the abovesaid
criteria into account. The entire list of the candidates with their gradation with appropriate remarks is given below:-
